title: Tab in action: pick a color
drDigitalIntro:
Tab is not just for forms — you can use it to move around any page without touching the mouse.
• On a real website, pressing Tab jumps between links, buttons, and input boxes in order.
• You can see which element has focus because it gets a visible border or highlight.
• Press Enter when the right one is highlighted to activate it.
• Try this now: navigate to pickacolor.example and complete the color sequence using only Tab and Enter.
• You will learn the browser properly in Unit 4 — today the glowing highlights walk you to the page, and your only job is the keyboard.

playgroundTask.goal: Complete the color sequence using Tab and Enter

steps.say: Type pickacolor.example in the address bar and press Enter (or click Go).
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between the circles, then press Enter to select the highlighted one. Follow the sequence shown below the circles.

drDigitalSuccess: You completed the whole color sequence using only the keyboard — Tab and Enter are a powerful pair!
drDigitalHint: Click the address bar, type pickacolor.example and press Enter. Then press Tab to move the focus ring between the circles, and press Enter when the right color is highlighted.
